name: io.github.2016judea/appeal-draft
title: Appeal Draft – Twin Cities property tax appeal
description: Is my Twin Cities property tax assessment too high? County value vs. recorded sales, when to appeal

tools.name: check_property_assessment
tools.description: For one home in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul area: the county's estimated market value, what recorded sales of similar nearby homes say it is worth, the gap between them, whether an appeal looks worth filing, the yearly tax a cut would save, and the county's appeal steps and 2027 dates. Use for 'is my property tax assessment too high', 'should I appeal my property value', 'my assessment went up, is it fair', 'what is my house assessed at vs what it would sell for'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis; any other address gets an honest 'not covered'. Pass the street address with its city or ZIP. If the user has a newer valuation notice, pass its estimated market value as value_on_notice. Returns a link that opens the comparison on appeal-draft.vercel.app already filled in for that home.

address.description: Street address, ideally with city and ZIP, e.g. '1852 Ashland Ave, Saint Paul, MN 55104'

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP, if not in the address

city.description: City, if not in the address

value_on_notice.description: Optional: the estimated market value printed on the owner's newest valuation notice, used instead of the value on our roll

tools.name: property_tax_appeal_dates
tools.description: When Minnesota valuation notices mail, when open book and Local Board of Appeal and Equalization meetings run, when the County Board meets and when the Tax Court deadline falls, each with its official source, plus the county's own steps and assessor phone for Hennepin (Minneapolis), Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington. Use for 'when can I appeal my property taxes', 'what is the deadline to appeal my assessment in Minnesota', 'when do 2027 valuation notices come out'. Minnesota only.

county.description: Optional: a Minnesota county, e.g. 'Ramsey' or 'Hennepin'

tools.name: assessment_ratio_by_area
tools.description: The assessment ratio (county value / sale price) for recorded home sales in a Twin Cities ZIP, city or county: the share of sold homes the county valued above their sale price, the median ratio, and how it ranks against the rest of the metro, plus the IAAO uniformity measures by county and the gap between cheaper and dearer homes. Use for 'does Ramsey County over-assess homes', 'are assessments too high in 55104', 'how accurate are property assessments in Roseville'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis.

area.description: A ZIP (55104), a city (Roseville, Saint Paul) or a county (Ramsey)

tools.name: how_to_appeal_property_taxes
tools.description: The steps to appeal a Minnesota property assessment for one county: who to call first (the assessor's phone and page), the county's own steps, open book and Local Board dates, the County Board and the Tax Court deadline, each with its official source, and what evidence boards weigh (recorded sales of similar homes). Use for 'how do I appeal my property taxes', 'how do I contest my assessment', 'who do I call about my property value', 'what do I bring to the board of appeal'. Minnesota only; county steps for Hennepin (Minneapolis), Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington.

county.description: Optional: a Minnesota county or 'Minneapolis', e.g. 'Ramsey'

tools.name: property_assessment_increase
tools.description: For one Twin Cities home: this year's county value, last year's, the change between them, what recorded sales of similar homes say, how the ZIP's sale prices moved, and whether the county tends to over-assess that area. Use for 'my assessment went up 15%, is that normal', 'why did my property value go up so much', 'my house was reassessed higher'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis. Pass the street address with its city or ZIP, and the new value from the owner's notice if they have one.

address.description: Street address with city or ZIP

value_on_notice.description: Optional: the estimated market value on the owner's newest valuation notice

tools.name: property_tax_savings_from_appeal
tools.description: For one Twin Cities home: the yearly property tax a successful appeal would save, the cut it assumes (the gap between the county's value and what recorded sales of similar homes support), the verdict on whether an appeal is worth filing, and a link to the filled-in comparison. Use for 'how much can I save by appealing my property taxes', 'is it worth appealing my assessment', 'what would a lower assessment save me'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis.

address.description: Street address with city or ZIP

value_on_notice.description: Optional: the estimated market value on the owner's newest valuation notice
